title: Terminal order statuses accept any transition
description: canTransition treats a status with an empty allowed-transition list as unrestricted (`allowed.length === 0 || ...`). Terminal statuses such as 'cancelled' and 'refunded' have empty lists, so a cancelled order can be paid or shipped.
reproduction: Place an order and cancel it.
The transition succeeds instead of throwing InvalidTransitionError.

failing_test.name: does not allow a cancelled order to be paid or shipped

expected_behavior: Terminal statuses reject every transition except re-applying the same status.
regression_tests: rejects moving a shipped order back to pending
treats re-applying the current status as a no-op
